items.summary: Replace the current site-wide “Dark Leather Premium” design tokens with the new logo-aligned Navy + Gold luxury palette across the entire frontend, using the exact colors: Background #0F1B2D, Secondary Dark #141F33, Gold Accent #C8A24D, Soft Cream Text #F4EFE6, Muted Gold Divider #B9933C. Update global CSS variables and Tailwind theme usage so existing components (header, footer, pages, cards, forms) automatically inherit the new palette without introducing bright blue UI.

Upgrade the header into a more premium, luxury-style navigation: make the header visually lighter and more refined by using a transparent/overlay treatment on the Home hero (with subtle blur), increased spacing, thinner nav typography, and replace the current active-state “filled pill” with a gold underline (or similarly subtle gold indicator). Keep mobile navigation functional and consistent with the new premium styling.

Integrate the provided logo into the top-left of the header in place of (or alongside) the plain text site name, sized appropriately for a premium look (not oversized), with adequate padding/clear space. Ensure the logo remains sharp on retina displays and visually harmonizes with the new navy+gold palette.

Refine buttons site-wide to feel more premium: primary buttons should use gold background with navy text; secondary/outline buttons should use gold borders with cream text; hover should invert (gold ↔ navy) with smooth transitions and subtle elevation. Apply this consistently to key CTAs including “View Products”, “Request Catalogue”, “Send Inquiry”, and “Contact Us”.

Reduce the “boxy template” feel on product/category cards and highlight blocks by removing heavy borders, using subtler shadows, and adding refined gold detailing (thin gold divider lines under section titles where appropriate). Add a restrained hover interaction (slight zoom + soft gold glow) to category cards and key cards while keeping motion subtle.

Improve typography hierarchy to feel more “luxury”: increase heading presence (size/weight/letter-spacing choices) while keeping body text lighter with increased line-height and spacing. Ensure typography is consistent across pages and components (header, hero, section titles, accordions, form labels).

Add subtle luxury detailing and depth across the site: implement thin gold separators between major sections and optional small gold accent markers for bullet-like lists where they exist, without clutter. Add a very subtle leather-like texture overlay on the main dark backgrounds at ~5% opacity so the navy is not perfectly flat.
